correctness.rationale: The witness certificate was independently reconstructed. The 18 point conditions plus all 28 affine jets of total order below seven at \(P_0=[3:5:1]\) give a \(46\times45\) matrix annihilating the supplied octic coefficient vector; fresh modular elimination at primes 1000003 and 1000033 gives rank 44, so the kernel is exactly one-dimensional. Translation to \(P_0\) has only degree-seven and degree-eight pieces. Their dehomogenizations are coprime, and the degree-seven piece is nonzero in the direction at infinity, so no line through \(P_0\) divides the octic. If a degree-eight curve of multiplicity seven were reducible, the sum of degree-minus-multiplicity deficits over factors would be one; with at least two factors, some positive-degree factor has equal degree and multiplicity and therefore splits into lines through \(P_0\), contradiction. Thus the witness is absolutely irreducible. The source supplies generic one-dimensionality; the nonzero rank-44 minor keeps the kernel a line near the witness, and reducible octics form a Zariski-closed subset, so irreducibility holds for general assigned point.
